meta.title: 拍视频为何不用曝光三要素？
meta.title_en: Why Don't You Use the Exposure Triangle for Video?

scenes.title_cn: 开场：光圈、快门、ISO为何过时了？…
scenes.title_en: Opening: why have aperture, shutter, and I…
scenes.context: 视频时代让曝光三要素过时。
sentences: 在2026年，我们默认摄影师必须照片视频双修的年代，这道摄影圣经似乎开始悄悄过时。
In 2026, when photographers must master both photo and video, this bible quietly becomes dated.
photo-video dual（照片视频双修）
今天我们来聊聊为何拍视频不用曝光三要素。
Today: why not use the exposure triangle for video.
why not in video（为何视频不用）
paraphrase: why not in video（为何视频不用
why not in video（为何视频不用
scenes.speak: In 2026, when photographers must master both photo and video, this bible quietly becomes dated. Today: why not use the exposure triangle for video.

scenes.title_cn: ISO为什么不能调：现代相机里有一二…
scenes.title_en: Why ISO is fixed: modern cameras offer a d…
sentences: 现代相机里有一二十个ISO档位让我们随时调用，但电影工业里感光度只有一个，ISO800。
Modern cameras offer many ISO settings, but film uses only one: ISO 800.
only ISO 800（只有ISO800）
胶片是无法回看的，随意更换胶卷会打乱拍摄的进度表。
Film can't be reviewed; swapping rolls breaks the schedule.
can't be reviewed（无法回看）
任何一个现在我们看似翻江倒海的动作，都远比以前换一盘胶卷保险的多。
Any extreme action now was far safer than swapping a roll back then.
safer than before（更保险）
scenes.speak: Modern cameras offer many ISO settings, but film uses only one: ISO 800. Film can't be reviewed; swapping rolls breaks the schedule. Any extreme action now was far safer than swapping a roll back then.

scenes.title_cn: 原生感光度：胶片年代，胶卷的ASA和…
scenes.title_en: Native ISO: in the film era, ASA and color…
scenes.context: 原生感光度之外都是数字增益。
sentences: 胶卷的ASA和色温都被视作艺术表现工具，而不是曝光工具。
Film ASA and color temp were artistic tools, not exposure tools.
artistic tool（艺术工具）
除了原生感光度，其他的感光度是模拟出来的，也称数字增益。
Other than native ISO, every setting is simulated—digital gain.
digital gain（数字增益）
scenes.speak: Film ASA and color temp were artistic tools, not exposure tools. Other than native ISO, every setting is simulated—digital gain.

scenes.title_cn: 800黄金标准与趋势：所以为了得到画…
scenes.title_en: The 800 gold standard and trends: to get t…
scenes.context: ISO800是黄金标准，双原生是未来。
sentences: ARRI摄影机的原生ISO就是800，被誉为黄金标准。
ARRI's native ISO is 800—the gold standard.
gold standard（黄金标准）
当然也有导演不遵守这套法则，故意提高感光度去获得高噪点的画面。
Some directors raise ISO deliberately for grainy looks.
break the rule（打破法则）
当下最火热的技术方向是双原生甚至三原生ISO。
The hottest direction is dual-native or even triple-native ISO.
dual-native ISO（双原生ISO）
scenes.speak: ARRI's native ISO is 800—the gold standard. Some directors raise ISO deliberately for grainy looks. The hottest direction is dual-native or even triple-native ISO.

scenes.title_cn: 光圈为什么不能调：其实有个问题你应该…
scenes.title_en: Why aperture is fixed: you've probably bee…
scenes.context: 光圈调曝光忽略了景深代价。
sentences: 电影是一门蓄势的艺术，而不是技术的艺术。
Film is an art of restraint, not an art of technique.
art of restraint（蓄势的艺术）
调节光圈往往忽略了很重要的代价，那就是景深。
Adjusting aperture ignores a big cost: depth of field.
the cost is DOF（代价是景深）
提高景深，就可以给两个人物更多的表演区域。
Deepening DOF gives both actors more room to perform.
more acting room（更多表演区）
paraphrase: the cost is DOF（代价是景深
the cost is DOF（代价是景深
scenes.speak: Film is an art of restraint, not an art of technique. Adjusting aperture ignores a big cost: depth of field. Deepening DOF gives both actors more room to perform.

scenes.title_cn: 跟焦与艺术蓄势：而且电影拍摄从来不会…
scenes.title_en: Focus pulling and artistic restraint: film…
scenes.context: 浅景深是跟焦员噩梦，电影靠景深叙事。
sentences: 电影拍摄从来不会用自动对焦，跟焦都是活人手动完成。
Film never uses autofocus; focusing is done by hand.
hand focus（手动跟焦）
电影拍摄光圈开到T2.8已经被视为是非常大的光圈。
Opening to T2.8 is already a very large aperture in film.
T2.8 is big（T2.8已很大）
电影依赖景深来展示剧情线索，前景和背景其实都是展示剧情的重要位置。
Film uses DOF for story cues—foreground and background both matter.
front and back（前后景）
scenes.speak: Film never uses autofocus; focusing is done by hand. Opening to T2.8 is already a very large aperture in film. Film uses DOF for story cues—foreground and background both matter.

scenes.title_cn: 公民凯恩与整体联动：导演、摄影、美术…
scenes.title_en: Citizen Kane and full integration: the dir…
scenes.context: 光圈是全片设计的一环，现场只微调。
sentences: 经典作品《公民凯恩》利用了超景深的摄影手法，开拓出巨大的表演区域。
Citizen Kane used deep focus to open up a huge acting area.
deep focus（超景深）
光圈在电影拍摄中不只是技术工具，而是艺术蓄势工具。
In film, aperture is an artistic tool, not just technical.
artistic tool（艺术工具）
光圈定好了，画面太暗加灯光，画面太亮加ND。
With the aperture set: dark means more light, bright means ND.
light or ND（加灯或ND）
scenes.speak: Citizen Kane used deep focus to open up a huge acting area. In film, aperture is an artistic tool, not just technical. With the aperture set: dark means more light, bright means ND.

scenes.title_cn: 快门为什么不能调：出于艺术的考量，感…
scenes.title_en: Why the shutter is fixed: for artistic rea…
scenes.context: 180度原则让快门固定，为电影感。
sentences: 简单的回答就是180度原则，为了电影感。
The simple answer is the 180-degree rule, for the cinematic feel.
180-degree rule（180度原则）
但一旦到了拍视频，调节快门可是犯了大忌。
But in video, touching the shutter is a big taboo.
big taboo（犯大忌）
电影的快门速度只有一个，那就是48分之1秒。
Film has only one shutter speed: 1/48s.
one shutter speed（唯一快门）
人眼的帧率也是动态的，完全取决于你的注意力和生命机能。
The eye's frame rate is dynamic—it depends on attention and biological function.
dynamic attention（动态注意）
scenes.speak: The simple answer is the 180-degree rule, for the cinematic feel. But in video, touching the shutter is a big taboo. Film has only one shutter speed: 1/48s. The eye's frame rate is dynamic—it depends on attention and biological function.

scenes.title_cn: 动态模糊与实验：光线通过晶体成像落在…
scenes.title_en: Motion blur and the experiment: light land…
scenes.context: 视觉暂留是动态模糊的原理。
sentences: 感光细胞产生的化学信号不会瞬间消失，大概会持续10分之1到15分之1秒。
Photoreceptor signals persist about 1/10 to 1/15 of a second.
persist briefly（短暂持续）
大脑会合成这段时间内光所发生的所有变化成为一段快照，被称之为视觉暂留。
The brain composites all changes into one snapshot—persistence of vision.
persistence of vision（视觉暂留）
手电筒的光造成更强的刺激，感光细胞需要更长时间恢复敏感度。
Stronger light means photoreceptors take longer to recover sensitivity.
stronger stimulus（更强刺激）
scenes.speak: Photoreceptor signals persist about 1/10 to 1/15 of a second. The brain composites all changes into one snapshot—persistence of vision. Stronger light means photoreceptors take longer to recover sensitivity.

scenes.context: 24帧是声音时代标准，180度造就自然模糊。
sentences: 设定一个兼容声音画面并且稳定播放的标准帧率，成为了不得不解决的问题。
A rate compatible with sound and picture became a must-solve problem.
sound and picture（声画兼容）
如果播放的画面过于清晰，人眼能开始觉察到眼前播放的是一张张单独的图片。
Too-sharp frames reveal themselves as individual pictures.
too sharp（过于清晰）
180度的镂空角度形成这种自然的动态模糊，我们依旧沿用当年的快门角度原则。
The 180-degree opening yields natural motion blur—we still follow the rule.
shutter angle rule（快门角度原则）
scenes.speak: A rate compatible with sound and picture became a must-solve problem. Too-sharp frames reveal themselves as individual pictures. The 180-degree opening yields natural motion blur—we still follow the rule.

scenes.title_cn: 规矩可以打破：当然180度快门是人定…
scenes.title_en: The rule can be broken: of course, the 180…
scenes.context: 180度可打破，是工业遗产的视觉烙印。
sentences: 电影人通过提高快门速度，模拟战争现场感。
Filmmakers raise the shutter to simulate the battlefield feel.
battlefield feel（战争现场感）
这个原则是工业历史的遗产，而电影标准被沿用了100多年。
It's an industrial legacy used for over a hundred years.
industrial legacy（工业遗产）
已经在人类文明基因中形成视觉烙印，我们本能认为这就是电影感。
A visual imprint in the culture—we instinctively feel this is cinema.
visual imprint（视觉烙印）
scenes.speak: Filmmakers raise the shutter to simulate the battlefield feel. It's an industrial legacy used for over a hundred years. A visual imprint in the culture—we instinctively feel this is cinema.

practice: Video made the exposure triangle quietly outdated.
Film locks one sensitivity: ISO 800, the gold standard.
Aperture changes ignore the cost of depth of field.
Hand focus pulls steer attention; shallow DOF tortures the puller.
The shutter is set by the 180-degree rule per frame rate.
pitfalls: Adjust the three factors freely for video.
Film locks ISO, aperture, and shutter for art.
电影里三要素不可乱调。
Swap film rolls for bad light.
Adjust exposure, ND, or push/pull instead.
Shallow DOF hurts acting space and story.
Focus is pulled by hand, aided not replaced.
Slow the shutter when dark in video.
shifts: 用 exposure triangle（曝光三要素）、gold standard（黄金标准）、180-degree rule（180度原则）
说景深只会说 depth of field
用 acting space（表演区域）、focus puller（跟焦员）、artistic restraint（蓄势表达）
用 persistence of vision（视觉暂留）、shutter angle（快门角度）、industrial legacy（工业遗产）
